on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue - System and Unexpected

logger.doc:name: Logger ERROR
logger.message: #["ERROR | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.originalRequest.batchId default vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default "N/A") | eventId=$(vars.inventoryEvent.event.eventId default vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default "N/A") | flow=$(flow.name) | errorType=$(error.errorType.namespace):$(error.errorType.identifier) | code=$(vars.errorInfo.code) | description=$(error.description default "")"]

logger.doc:name: Logger WARN
logger.message: #["REJECTED | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.originalRequest.batchId default vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default "N/A") | eventId=$(vars.inventoryEvent.event.eventId default vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default "N/A") | flow=$(flow.name) | errorType=$(error.errorType.namespace):$(error.errorType.identifier) | code=$(vars.errorInfo.code) | description=$(error.description default "")"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, batchId: vars.originalRequest.batchId default vars.inventoryRequest.batchId default null, eventId: vars.inventoryEvent.event.eventId default vars.inventoryEvent.eventId default null, failedFlow: flow.name, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default ""), failureReason: error.description default "", failedAt: now(), originalPayload: vars.inventoryEvent default vars.originalRequest default vars.inventoryRequest default null }

logger.doc:name: Logger DLQ
logger.message: #["DLQ | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | event sent to ${dlq.queueName}"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var info = vars.errorInfo var ev = vars.inventoryEvent.event default null --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: info.status, errorCode: info.code, message: info.message, correlationId: vars.correlationId default correlationId, validationReasons: [ { code: info.code, message: if (info.httpStatus >= 500) "See logs for this correlationId" else (error.description default info.message), category: info.category, retryable: info.retryable } ] } ++ (if (ev != null) { eventId: ev.eventId default null, sku: ev.sku default null, locationCode: ev.locationCode default null } else {})

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: if (vars.errorInfo.level == "WARN" and vars.inventoryEvent.event != null) 200 else vars.errorInfo.httpStatus

%dw 2.0 output application/java var st = (payload.status default "UNKNOWN") as String --- { status: st, isStale: ["STALE", "IGNORE_STALE", "IGNORED_STALE"] contains st, isConflict: ["CONFLICT", "VERSION_CONFLICT"] contains st }

%dw 2.0 output application/java var results = (payload.results default []) as Array fun statusOf(item) = ((item.status default item.outcome default "") as String) --- { batchId: payload.batchId default "N/A", processed: sizeOf(results), accepted: sizeOf(results filter ((item) -> statusOf(item) == "ACCEPTED")), stale: sizeOf(results filter ((item) -> ["STALE", "IGNORE_STALE", "IGNORED_STALE"] contains statusOf(item))), duplicate: sizeOf(results filter ((item) -> ["DUPLICATE", "IGNORE_DUPLICATE"] contains statusOf(item))), rejected: sizeOf(results filter ((item) -> statusOf(item) == "REJECTED")), versionConflict: sizeOf(results filter ((item) -> ["CONFLICT", "VERSION_CONFLICT"] contains statusOf(item))) }

logger.doc:name: Logger METRIC
logger.message: #["METRIC | correlationId=$(vars.correlationId default correlationId) | batchId=$(vars.batchMetrics.batchId) | processed=$(vars.batchMetrics.processed) | accepted=$(vars.batchMetrics.accepted) | stale=$(vars.batchMetrics.stale) | duplicate=$(vars.batchMetrics.duplicate) | rejected=$(vars.batchMetrics.rejected) | versionConflict=$(vars.batchMetrics.versionConflict)"]
